editorial:
Imagine being stuck in a secret desert base with a survivor from a space mission, only to find out he is carrying a deadly alien spider inside him. That is exactly the mess you get into with this movie. You follow Marci Eyre, a curious reporter who just wants the truth, but she ends up in a fight for her life. The vibe is very much like those old-school creature features where everything that can go wrong does go wrong. It starts with a space accident and quickly turns into a game of cat and mouse in a dusty facility. 

While the special effects are a bit dated, the tension stays high and the pacing keeps you moving. You will probably find some of the acting a bit over the top, but that actually adds to the campy fun. It is a great pick if you love B-movies that do not take themselves too seriously. If you can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, go for it, or maybe just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. Adding the Blu-ray to your physical collection is also a smart move if you love collecting weird sci-fi gems.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, the giant spider tries to escape the facility to reach the outside world. Marci and the remaining crew have to use everything they have to trap the beast. After a chaotic fight, they manage to kill the creature before it can break out into the desert. The movie ends with the threat finally gone, though it leaves you wondering how many other experiments like this are still hidden away by the government.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cheesy monster movies and space accidents.
